data.content_ref: inline:The proposed integration is unsupported: SRC_003 and SRC_004 describe causally independent forbidden cases (identity weakening vs. temporal reordering), so composing them into one mutation does not establish a substantive dependence or shared mechanism between the endpoints — at best it creates a compound test, not a relation. The target's own refutation condition confirms the two mutations are independent, which means pairing them into a single skeleton is an aggregation of separate checks rather than an integration of a single attack surface.
